messages:
anya: Quick preflight — planning to push platform release candidate 2026.03.1 on 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Draft release notes: https://redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-1. Need eng/runtime, docs, and support sign-off by EOD today. Ops: confirm standby window and rollback criteria.

sam: Ack. Can we keep a pinned rollback image handy? propose: registry.redwood/inference:2026-03-23-stable. Also want to confirm canary percentage and auto-promote rules.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. Mode: canary -> us-west1 -> 5% traffic for 10m, auto-promote if error_rate < 0.5% and p95 latency delta < 150ms. Will post status to #eng-oncall during rollout.

marie: I pushed copy edits to the RN doc. Added a Known Issue section: "transient KV cache growth under long-prefix sequences" + suggested mitigation (reduce max_prefix_cache to 8k for affected services).

leo: Ops standby: I'll be oncall for the window. Proposed rollback criteria:
- API error rate > 1.0% sustained over 5m
- OR p95 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows
- OR canary reports malformed responses > 0.1%
Rollback command (k8s):
```
kubectl set image deployment/inference runtime=registry.redwood/inference:2026-03-23-stable -n redwood-prod
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference -n redwood-prod
```
I'll also keep a hot snapshot of autoscaler and memcached configs.

anya: Thanks — I'll add those rollback bullets to the RN. For announcement copy, draft to run in internal channels: 
```
Heads up — rolling platform update (2026.03.1) tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This is a rolling canary deploy; most traffic unaffected. Expect short transient latency for a small subset of requests during canary. If you see user-facing issues, ping #eng-oncall and include request IDs. See internal RN: https://redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-1
```

docs-bot: Internal page updated; I can schedule an internal-all message 30m after promote (02:30 UTC) with the short blurb. Also adding a Support FAQ snippet under the RN.

sam: Confirm: no changes to model-catalog pins in this rollout. Dedicated customers will receive account-rep notices after promote. I'll coordinate the customer notify templates.

marie: Support blurb ready for booking: "No action required. Ops will handle failover. If customers report degraded latency, collect request IDs and escalate to ops-oncall." I'll add to the RN and a one-paragraph note for CS.

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll monitor telemetry dashboards and keep the rollback image staged in the private registry. If we initiate rollback, I'll escalate to the exec on-call and open a quick incident doc.

anya: Great. If no objections by EOD PST I'll mark the RN final, schedule the canary, and trigger deploy-bot. Please :thumbsup: or call out anything missing.

sam: :thumbsup:
marie: :thumbsup: minor copy nits fixed
leo: :thumbsup: on rollback criteria
deploy-bot: Will post canary start ping 5m before deploy
ops-oncall: I'll be available during the window, +1
anya: Thanks everyone — will post final RN and announce in #eng and #internal-all after promote.
